title: Inventory preset and widget setting contract
description: Map the current preset storage, widget settings, admin save shape, runtime config, and serialization risks before implementing widget-side save/load behavior.
objective: Define what a Filter Controller preset is, which settings belong to it, which settings remain local to a widget instance, and how the preset shape can evolve without data loss.
acceptance_criteria: Every current preset field is classified as persisted, derived, deprecated, local-only, or unknown.
Every widget setting needed for filter composition is classified.
The plan identifies whether visual Style settings are preset-owned, local overrides, or deferred.
Existing saved presets remain readable under the proposed schema.
Save/load implementation is not started inside this task.
verification: No plugin source changes are made.
Inventory document links every conclusion to inspected files.

budgets.context_budget: preset support, admin preset form, widget settings, runtime config
budgets.validation_budget: Agentic Ops validation plus git status

risks: Treating style settings as globally reusable too early may make presets brittle.
Failing to distinguish linked and detached semantics can create accidental mutation of shared presets.
